capabilities: Import one, several, or all new player-safe session recaps as Markdown notes
Detect previous imports by stable session ID, including moved or renamed notes
Preview exact destination paths before writing files
Optionally import normalized transcripts as linked notes beneath recaps
Create a campaign index note with a live Obsidian query
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); mobile may be evaluated later. Warns that Obsidian SecretStorage entries are not isolated from other plugins and that transcripts may contain private GM material, so a dedicated vault is advised. Imports are create-only: existing notes are never overwritten, updated, renamed, moved, or deleted. Transcript importing is off by default and requires permission in both the export key and plugin settings. A narrow migration limitation from version 1.2.0 or earlier means prior imports moved outside the managed Sessions folder may be re-imported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull session recaps from a Recap Raven campaign into local Markdown notes without manual copying and duplicate risk.

relations.evidence: Import player-safe Recap Raven session recaps into your vault as structured, local Markdown

requires.name: Recap Raven account with an active campaign
campaign-bound Obsidian export key (raven_obs_…), stored via Obsidian SecretStorage

summary: Importer that brings player-safe Recap Raven session recaps into a vault as structured Markdown, with duplicate detection and campaign indexes.
